params.name: opts
params.doc: a scene id or Scene, bare or as opts.sceneId; default: the viewed scene

methods.returns: { policy, combatOnScene, allowed, reason, wish, ghost, ownedOnTop, patched: { drag, keyboard }, sceneId, version, settings: { <key>: scope }, combatExempt: string[] }
methods.doc: Why ghost is or isn't on for this client on a scene (opts.sceneId, default the viewed one): the GM policy, whether a combat there stops ghosting, this client's button (wish), whether the two core methods are wrapped, every setting key with its scope (ghost and ownedOnTop are client settings), and combatExempt: the ids of your tokens there that may ghost through the fight (incorporeal feat or the GM's flag; [] when no fight blocks).
Is ghost movement in effect for that token on this client (a player, owner, button on, allowed)? Always false on a GM client.

params.name: sceneId
params.doc: a scene id or a Scene; default: the viewed scene

methods.doc: Does a combat stop ghosting on that scene (an active encounter there with a visible combatant, or started)? Hidden combatants do not count.

params.name: on
params.type: boolean | Actor | Token | TokenDocument | uuid | id | exact name
params.doc: a boolean: your own button (legacy); a creature reference: the GM's ghost-in-combat override for it

params.name: opts
params.doc: with a creature reference only: combat true sets flags.pentaryn-movement.ghostInCombat, false clears it

methods.returns: Promise<void> (boolean) | Promise<{ ok, uuid, name, ghostInCombat, feat } | { ok: false, code, reason }> (reference)
methods.doc: setGhost(true|false): switch ghost on or off for yourself, like the player's button (player clients only: on a GM client, and so from the MCP bridge, it sets the GM's own client setting, which changes nothing for players). setGhost(creature, { combat }): GM only — let that creature's owner ghost it during a fight (the actor flag ghostInCombat; a token's synthetic actor keeps it on that token); NOT_GM, NOT_FOUND, AMBIGUOUS or BAD_ARGS as a refusal object. A feat named Incorporeal Passage / Incorporeal Movement / Ethereal grants the same without the flag.
GM: set the player ghost policy. Rejects with Error('GM only') on a player client (legacy: a throw, not a refusal object). A mode other than off is also remembered for the GM toolbar button.

params.name: scene
params.doc: a Scene or a scene id; default: the viewed scene

methods.doc: Map pins whose centre sits under a visible token (owned-on-top makes them unclickable for that player); player-owned tokens first. A pin limited to other scene levels than the token's is skipped. [] without a scene or for an unknown scene id.

params.name: ref
params.type: Actor | Token | TokenDocument | uuid | id | exact name
params.doc: a creature; a token gives its own (synthetic) actor

methods.doc: Read-only ghost-in-combat state of one creature, plain JSON: flag (the GM override flags.pentaryn-movement.ghostInCombat), feat (the incorporeal feat's name, or null) and ghostInCombat (either grants it). Options are ignored.

methods.returns: { mode, mine, smoothCorners, patched, gridType, memo, limits, last: { at, tokenId, legs, found, nodes, ms, reached, of, arcs, improved, async, memo } | null }
methods.doc: Drag pathfinding on this client: the world mode (everyone / gm / off), this client's two settings, whether Token#findMovementPath is wrapped, the step-cache size, the search limits, and what the last search did (nodes expanded, ms, explicit waypoints reached of how many, arcs placed, whether it beat the straight drag).

params.name: opts
params.type: { to: { x, y }, preview?: boolean, smooth?: boolean }
params.doc: to: the destination top-left in pixels; preview: count only walls this user has seen (default false); smooth: corner arcs (default this client's setting)

methods.returns: { ok, reached, straight, waypoints: [{ x, y, explicit }], cost, arcs, legs: [{ state, nodes, corners, arcs }], ms } | { ok: false, reason }
methods.doc: Dry run of a drag: the path the pathfinder would give that token to opts.to, without moving it. Needs a drawn canvas (a browser tab, not the headless GM). straight: the plain drag already got there; cost in feet as the ruler measures it.
Live smoke checks after a sync: published, settings readable, both core methods wrapped, hooks registered.

settings.doc: GM policy for player ghost movement: off, exploration (off while a combat runs on the scene) or always.
The mode the GM toolbar button restores when it is switched back on (exploration or always).
This player's ghost button (their wish); in effect only while the policy allows it. Client scope.
Draw this player's own tokens on top, on their screen only. Client scope.
Drag pathfinding around walls: everyone (default), gm (GM drags only) or off. Read live on every drag.
This client's drags find a path around walls (when the world setting allows it). Client scope.
Round a found path's corners into arcs where that stays clear of walls and costs no extra movement. Client scope.
